summary: Exclude the quorum-device vote from pool host membership

guide.reason: The change corrects internal quorum parsing before the witness workflow exists; no operator step changes.

api.reason: LocalQuorum host membership now excludes native qdevice node ID 0; the existing pool fencing readiness/proof result keeps its shape and can no longer count the witness as a host.

roadmap.reason: The two-host witness design records the parser prerequisite; witness registration and proof remain unimplemented.

state.reason: Only native runtime quorum output parsing changes; no durable pool or Controller record is added.

verification.method: The focused regression failed against the prior parser with Qdevice in Hosts and passed after the fix; go test ./internal/vmhost passed. Native qdevice partition evidence is in the separate lab record; no Nex witness proof ran.
